prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity compositional option A for the Grădina Kasper desktop homepage, 1536×1024 landscape
Primary request: Refine the selected “Friendly Weekly Harvest” direction without changing its fundamental split composition. Preserve the first reference image’s topology: real human greenhouse photography on the left, a dominant featured vegetable-box purchase module on the right, and a compact real website navigation. This is a mature friendly ecommerce interface, not a literal planner and not a poster.
Structure: Existing homepage information architecture only. Compact navigation; hero message and human greenhouse image; featured product “Cutia Family” with photograph, 150 RON, 4–5 kg, next date 28.09.2026, and “Adaugă în coș”; then the beginning of the existing highlighted-articles section at the fold. Do not add a how-it-works section, calendar, subscription, or meal planner.
Visual system: friendly rounded grotesk typography, confident large radii, generous whitespace, clear tonal panels that separate sections without borders. Use almost no outlines: reserve a thin line only for a secondary button or active state. Remove coral and all unrelated colors.
Limited palette only: primary-50 #eefbf2, primary-100 #d6f5de, primary-300 #7dd8a0, primary-600 #17844a, primary-900 #005621, primary-950 #072718; secondary-50 #f5f9ec, secondary-200 #c6dc9a, secondary-500 #7ca33f, secondary-800 #3e5024; white may be used as a neutral canvas. Deep #005621 is the anchor; pale #eefbf2 and #f5f9ec are surfaces; #c6dc9a is the restrained playful accent.
Exact visible Romanian text: “Grădina Kasper”; “Din grădina noastră. Direct pe masa ta. Proaspăt din Brașov.”; “Creștem legume netratate, într-o grădină vie, și ți le aducem proaspete la tine acasă!”; “Cutia Family”; “150 RON”; “4–5 kg”; “Următoarea livrare: 28.09.2026”; “Adaugă în coș”; “Vezi toate cele 18 cutii”; “Articole recomandate”.
Constraints: preserve a real ecommerce reading order and clickable controls; featured box is immediately purchasable; real greenhouse story is visible; friendly, lightly playful, never luxury or childish; existing footer direction remains compatible; no invented claims.
Avoid: excessive borders, bordered card grids, coral, orange, red, purple, gradients, glassmorphism, generic ShadCN, literal fridge magnets, handwritten clutter, subscription UI, meal-planning UI, new sections, certification badges, testimonials, discounts, ratings, fake statistics, poster composition, device frame, watermark.
